company.name: Impactive
company.shortDescription: We’re Impactive (formerly Outvote), a digital organizing hub for progressive campaigns and causes.
company.description: Impactive (formerly Outvote) is an all-in-one suite of tools for organizing, outreach, and engagement. We empower progressive campaigns and causes to fundraise, share their stories and actions, get out the vote, and much more.

productsAndServices.description: A platform feature enabling volunteers to send personalized one-to-one text messages to supporters at scale for outreach and mobilization.
productsAndServices.name: Peer-to-Peer Texting

productsAndServices.description: A mass messaging tool that sends opt-in broadcast texts to supporters for fundraising, event reminders, and calls to action.
productsAndServices.name: Broadcast Texting

productsAndServices.description: A phone outreach tool featuring a predictive dialer for efficient patch-through calling and maximizing volunteer call time.
productsAndServices.name: Phone Banking with Predictive Dialer

productsAndServices.description: Tools enabling volunteers to reach personal contacts via multiple channels including text, email, calls, and social media for organizing and outreach.
productsAndServices.name: Relational Organizing and Canvassing

productsAndServices.description: A feature to create branded forms for event RSVPs, volunteer sign-ups, pledges, and other supporter data collection.
productsAndServices.name: Custom Forms

productsAndServices.description: An integration that facilitates supporter sharing of pre-generated social media content to expand campaign reach organically.
productsAndServices.name: Social Media Amplification Integration

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $5,967,882 to $6,692,235, a 1.12x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
